caption:
The Gravel Expedition ends at the Pacific. On Day 6, we ride 59.2 km north from Nosara past San Juanillo, Marbella, Playa Negra, and Avellanas to reach Tamarindo. It is a day of 782 metres of climbing, with the Guanacaste surf coast to our left.

We stay at Hotel Capitán Suizo, located at the south end of the bay. Day 7 is a 23.8 km loop through the inland crossroads at Huacas down to the shell beach at Playa Conchal. By the time you reach the sand, the 356 km crossing of the Nicoya Peninsula is behind you.

The Gravel Expedition. Next departures 23 to 31 January 2027 and 3 to 11 July 2027. Details in the bio.
